speech.text: 10 Weird Things You Didn't Know About The Conjuring House First off, when the Perron family arrived in 1971, almost immediately strange things started happening. While the daughters were carrying boxes into the house, they saw a man standing in the dining room. One of the daughters went to check, but the man had disappeared. Even weirder, objects started moving on their own. Doors with slam and empty rooms, and unexplained noises began. The fourth daughter, Cindy, once experienced multiple voices surrounding her bed, repeating the same sentence. There are seven dead soldiers, buried in the wall. The voices got so loud that the floorboards in her bed started shaking. A few days later, the daughters also reported seeing shadow figures moving around the house, sometimes seeing dark shapes pass through rooms. Next, when paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren arrived, they held a seance during which the mother suddenly began speaking in an unknown language. Her body then started lifting off the ground while she was sitting in the chair. Lastly, after the parents finally moved out, another couple lived there for 32 years without reporting anything similar.
